findings.title: Impossible calendar dates (e.g. Feb 30) are silently rolled over instead of rejected
findings.why: Validation relies on a regex plus Date.parse returning NaN. From memory, V8 accepts days 1-31 for every month and rolls over, so 2026-02-30T00:00:00Z parses as 2026-03-02. A request such as 2026-02-30 to 2026-03-05 is quoted and booked as 2 to 5 March instead of throwing. The test case for 2026-02-30 only passes because the rolled-over start equals the end. parseHourUtc has the same flaw. A fix would check that the parsed date's ISO string matches the input date fields, or check the day against the month length.
